entries.AcceptBirthdayGift_Negative: Oh! I've read about this tradition... it's a 'birthday gift', isn't it?#$b#So, is it part of the tradition to give out garbage like this?
entries.AcceptBirthdayGift_Positive: Oh! I've read about this tradition... it's a 'birthday gift', isn't it? Hmm, very interesting...
entries.AcceptGift_(O)StardropTea: *sniff*... is this milk? *sip*... hmm... tastes good.
entries.AcceptGift_Neutral_milk_item: Ah, 'milk'... *slurp*... How interesting. Remind me, again... where exactly does this juice come from?#$b#...!!! *sploosh*
entries.Fri: You've never seen a dwarf before, have you?
entries.Fri_2: Most humans fear the unknown... that's why I've hidden my shop here.#$e#Your mining skills prove you're trustworthy.
entries.GreenRain: I can't see the color green very well.#$b#I guess it's part of living underground for so long.
entries.Introduction: Hey, you're pretty good at mining, for a human.
entries.Mon: I got all this stuff from the surface. I just take it from your people during the night.#$e#Hmm? What is this concept you call "private property"?
entries.Sat: It's dangerous in the mines. Why don't you buy a few things from my shop to ensure your safety?
entries.Sat_8: The mines can be a treacherous place. Be careful, friend.
entries.Sun: One day you'll have to tell me about this beverage you call "milk".
entries.Thu: You're not a spy sent by the Shadow People, are you?#$e#I'm keeping my eye on you.
entries.Thu_4: I feel most comfortable underground.#$e#The deeper underground the better.
entries.Tue: Ah... cave carrot stew, cave carrot roast, cave carrot soup and cave carrots au gratin.#$e#...And a ramekin of cave carrot brulee to sweeten the night.#$e#What?
entries.Wed_6: Long ago, my people knew the secrets of advanced technology. The archaeological evidence proves that.#$e#But I wonder where it came from? And where did it all go? I guess some questions will never be answered...
entries.firstVisit_Caldera: You found the legendary Dwarvish Forge? Incredible... I've never seen it, myself.#$e#The machinery is so old, none of my people understand how it works. But it's definitely Dwarvish technology.
entries.firstVisit_IslandNorth: If you enter the volcano on Ginger Island, you might encounter others like me. Don't be alarmed! We're peaceful with humans.
entries.fishCaught_158: Oh, you caught a Stonefish? I know them very well. We sometimes keep them as pets.
entries.fishCaught_161: Oh, you caught an Ice Pip? They're energetic little fish, despite the frigid environment they live in. My people avoid the frozen areas, though... too cold!
entries.fishCaught_162: Oh, you caught a Lava Eel? Very good! Lava Eel fishing is a big part of our culture. They're considered a delicacy!
entries.mineArea_121: You know, you're pretty good at mining, for a human.
